facts.fact: UNESCO states Kenya has enacted the Access to Information Act (2016), with a constitutional guarantee under Article 35.
UNESCO reports that the Commission on Administrative Justice, with a commissioner in charge of access to information, has reported uneven compliance among public institutions.
